title: Indian physicist Deepak Dhar wins prestigious 2026 Dirac Medal
description: Physicist Deepak Dhar received the 2026 Dirac Medal for his statistical mechanics work. He shares the award with three other scientists for their complex systems research. Their contributions span biology, finance, computer science, and artificial intelligence. Dhar is recognized for his influential sandpile model research. This award highlights significant advancements in theoretical physics and its applications.

title: SBI uses AI to underwrite nearly Rs 1 lakh crore in MSME loans in FY26
description: State Bank of India underwrote nearly one lakh crore rupees in MSME loans using artificial intelligence. AI is also automating the processing of cheques up to ten thousand rupees. Benefits include improved customer satisfaction and employee efficiency.
